title: Import concept sets from another repository
description_text: Concept sets are matched by lineage (uniqueId): a new one is added, another version of one you have replaces it (keeping its id), the same version is skipped. Each import becomes your draft, recording where it came from.
repo_url_hint: A GitHub / GitLab repository, its Pages site, or a direct data.json URL.
file_url_hint: A raw JSON URL, or a GitHub / GitLab file page.
paste_placeholder: Paste a concept set JSON here
fetch_failed: Could not load from this URL ({{error}}).
error_not_a_concept_set: this does not look like a concept set
conflict_hint: A newer version replaces your copy, as a draft you can review before submitting.
